#4415 -- Validator needs to prevent invalid handle in AnnotateHandle
Look at the DXIL pane, at the call to @dx.op.annotateHandle (opcode 216).
Its first operand -- the resource handle -- is an all-zero handle: the
shader reads CBV while still initialising CBV, so there is no handle yet.
Both the front end and DXIL validation let this through; only the
-Wuninitialized warning fires, and the compiler exits 0.
Note this text is deliberately written without the exact LLVM spelling of
that operand, because Compiler Explorer copies the source into the module's
!dx.source.contents metadata -- searching the DXIL pane for the spelling
would otherwise find this banner rather than the instruction. (The issue
author's own comment block below does contain the spelling; it is quoted
verbatim from the issue and left untouched, so a text search of the DXIL
pane finds it there too. Read the annotateHandle call itself.)
